name: Black Stair L1: The Crossing, Weaponized

system.source: Bad Eden Bulwark + Shadow Courier v1.0 (RFI-native rules)

description.value:
A locked door is a suggestion.

Mode: Thief / drift: Toward.

Your default Package type is either a Blade or a Key. Declare which you are carrying at the start of each scene; you may switch on a Soma Break.

  • Blade. A single opportunistic strike, deployable once. While carrying a Blade, your first attack from concealment or surprise in the scene deals an extra +1d10x10 kinetic damage with damageFlavor: blade. The damage explodes on 10s and banks Surge as normal. Using the strike consumes the Blade.

  • Key. A single-use access bypass. While carrying a Key, you may bypass one non-magical lock, ward, or password challenge without rolling, once per scene. Using the Key consumes it.

On delivery (resolving the Blade strike on its intended target, or using the Key on its intended barrier): no Pace refill from this base feature — see Class Tier 3 Package Mastery for the Black Stair delivery bonus.

You may designate a new Package on your next Soma Break or on entering a new scene if your slot is empty.

system.requirements: Route of the Black Stair, Shadow Courier Initiation 1
